headline: Record fee income and monetizations power a profit surge
summary_short: KKR reported Q2 2026 revenue of $5,725.9M (+12.5% y/y) and diluted EPS of $0.70 (+40.0% y/y), with net income of $700.5M as Fee Related Earnings, Total Operating Earnings and Adjusted Net Income per share all set quarterly records.
summary_long: Revenue rose 12.5% y/y to $5,725.9M on growth in both Asset Management & Strategic Holdings and Insurance segment revenue. Fee Related Earnings reached a record $1,214.1M (+37% y/y) on higher management fees and fee-related performance revenues; Total Operating Earnings hit $1,539.4M (+29% y/y). Net income (before preferred dividends) was $700.5M, up 37.3% y/y; diluted EPS of $0.70 rose 40.0% y/y. AUM grew 16% y/y to $796.5B on $34.3B of new capital raised in the quarter, including the closed Arctos acquisition. Total cash rose 8.8% q/q to $21,202.2M and shareholders' equity rose 1.8% q/q to $31,047.4M. The board declared a $0.195/share common dividend for the quarter. No forward numeric guidance was issued in the release.
